logs.summary: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck the Banda Sea off Tual in Indonesia’s Maluku Province, with some early reports citing a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 before being revised or downgraded. Authorities reported no tsunami threat and no immediate casualties or structural damage.
